# The checks branch protection requires: job check names (a job's `name:`, or its id when it has none) of jobs
# that run on every pull request, with no label and no path filter, so they report on every pull request. Heavy
# `ci:` suites are advisory and never listed. scripts/test_ci_label_gate.py checks each entry.
# OpenAPI Spec Validation is left out while that workflow is disabled in the repository settings; it would never report.

Supply chain (locks, installs, image pins)
